Have you learned what you can on making {{Color TotK|Red|meals}} and {{Color TotK|Red|elixirs}}? Both consumables can bestow a variety of {{Color TotK|Red|effects}}. I am here to provide answers to any questions you might have.|Culinary Construct|TotK}}{{Cite|Effect|Salon|HWL}}
{{Cite|Effect|Salon|HWDE}} are a recurring mechanic in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Name Ref|EoW}} ==Overview== Added Effects are a type of buff that [[Link]] can acquire by consuming [[Meal]]s and [[Elixir]]s, or by equipping various pieces of [[Armor]]. They can buff Link in a variety of ways, from increasing his movement speed, to augmenting his combat prowess.{{Cite|Some results are {{Color TotK|Red|warming}}. Others may replenish {{Color TotK|Red|stamina}}. What effect you gain will depend on the ingredients. The {{Color TotK|Red|restless crickets}} hopping around here restore vigor when used in elixirs. This is one example. There are many others. The name often expresses the nature.|Culinary Construct|TotK}} Most Added Effects obtained through Meals or Elixirs will have a limited duration, determined by the [[Ingredients]] of the dish, while Added Effects obtained via Armor will be available for as long as the Armor piece is equipped. Some Added Effects can have different levels of potency, increasing their effectiveness. Certain Added Effects can stack to up to three total levels of potency, while others cap at one or two levels. When active, most Added Effects will be shown in the Inventory to the left of Link's model. The current level of potency, the max possible level, and the Added Effect's name and icon will all be displayed. Outside of the Inventory, active Meal or Elixir buffs will be shown below Link's [[Life Gauge]], provided that the Pro HUD option is disabled. Some Added Effects are not shown directly in the Inventory when active, but their existence may be indicated by an [[Item]]'s description. Link can only have one type of duration-based Added Effect from Meals or Elixirs active at a time. However, Added Effects can stack between Meals or Elixirs and Armor. This means that Link can have up to four different active buffs shown in the Inventory at a time, or if he has two pieces of Attack Up Armor equipped, he can consume a Meal or Elixir that grants a level one Attack Up Effect for a total of three levels. ===Set Bonuses=== {{Main|Set Bonus}} [[Set Bonus]]es are a rarer type of Added Effect obtained exclusively through certain [[Armor Set]]s. ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, there are 18 Added Effects that are visible in the Inventory when active and 13 that are hidden, totaling to 31 different Added Effects. In the [[Memory]] "[[Silent Princess (Memory)|Silent Princess]]", [[Zelda]] finds a [[Hot-Footed Frog]] and tells Link about its special properties,{{Cite|This delicacy is known to have very, very potent effects under the proper circumstances.|Zelda|BotW}}{{Cite|Research from the castle shows ingesting one of these can actually augment certain abilities.|Zelda|BotW}} referencing the Speed Up Effect that an Elixir made with a Hot-Footed Frog can provide. ====List of Added Effects==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |sortable= false |columns= Added Effect[Image][Link], Found On/Obtained From[IconList][Nowrap], Description[Description] |- | Attack Up | Barbarian Helm, Barbarian Armor, Barbarian Leg Wraps, Phantom Helmet, Phantom Armor, Phantom Greaves, Fierce Deity Mask, Fierce Deity Armor, Fierce Deity Boots, Mighty Bananas, Razorshroom, Mighty Thistle, Mighty Carp, Mighty Porgy, Razorclaw Crab, Bladed Rhino Beetle | Increases Link's attack power by 20%, 30% and 50% for levels one, two and three respectively. With the addition of new Armor pieces and Ingredients, there are 17 new Added Effects, eight of which are hidden. The glowing effect of the [[Radiant Set]] also received the name NightGlow. The Effects "Guardian Resist Up", "AncientPowUp", and "See Enemy HP" are no longer available within {{TotK|-}}. With 27 visible Effects and 19 hidden Effects available, there are 46 different Added Effects present in {{TotK|-}}. Several Added Effects were renamed or received small changes, such as the new mobility options for the Swim Up Waterfalls Effect. In {{TotK|-}}, Link can find several [[Well]]s containing [[Note on the Table|Notes on Tables]] written by [[Aurie Taamu]]. The Note on the Table in the [[Outskirt Hill Well]] describes the chef's experience eating a Meal made with [[Fire Fruit]]. The dish caused his strength to "light up like a flambé", enabling him to defeat monsters with ease, but did not protect him against the desert heat.{{Cite|Is the desert a harsh environment with extreme temperature differences? Sure. But a place of death? No! The desert's the place where life truly comes alive! A sandy sea of energy where you can draw out all of your power. After all, it was under that hot desert sun where I first dined on a dish made with fire fruit. I felt my {{Color TotK|Red|strength light up}} like a flambé. Monsters I struggled against before fell before me like flies! I'd never felt such joy, such strength! Then the desert heat overwhelmed me, and I collapsed in a heap. The moral is although fire fruit increases your strength, it {{Color TotK|Red|doesn't offer any protection from the heat}}. Power and protection—such a fine pairing that it's hard to choose one to give up. I am the man who eats his way through Hyrule's harshest environments.
-Chef Aurie Taamu, Wizard of Food|Note on the Table|TotK}} This effect is known as Hot Weather Attack, which augments Link's attacks with [[Fire]] when in unbearably hot climates. In the [[Side Quest]] "[[Gloom-Borne Illness]]", [[Lasli]]'s grandmother [[Nanna]] has fallen ill from [[Gloom]] sickness. If Link speaks to Lasli, she will explain to him that she has been trying to cook a [[Veggie Porridge]] to help cure the effects of the Gloom, but that she cannot find an Ingredient that works.{{Cite|Are you a traveler? I guess it doesn't really matter who you are, so long as you're willing to listen. You see, it's my grandmother... She got too close to that nasty {{Color TotK|Red|gloom}} stuff, and now she's sick and bedridden. {{Color TotK|Red|Porridge}} is about the only thing she can keep down right now too. I've been trying to mix in {{Color TotK|Red|ingredients that could help with gloom sickness}}... But none of them have had any effect. I need to cook a {{Color TotK|Red|porridge}} that will make my grandmother better, and I need to do it soon.|Lasli|TotK}} If Link cooks a Sunny Veggie Porridge and speaks to Lasli, he can give it to her so that she can use its Gloom Recovery Effect to cure her grandmother.{{Cite|Wh-what did you say this was, again? A sunny veggie porridge?

Appearances== ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Effects are enhancements for the [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]]. They are granted by changing the [[Fairy Clothing]] worn by Companion Fairies in the [[Salon]]. There are a total of ten Effects, with two Effects per [[Element]]. While Fairies can wear any Fairy Clothing, the Effect of the Clothing will only be active when worn by Fairies of the same Element as the Effect. Each Fairy can have upto five Effects at once, allowing active Effects to be stacked. ====List of Effects==== {{Data Table |game= HWDE |columns= Effect [Image][Link], Description [Description] |- | Fire Damage Up | Increases the power of [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Fire [[Element]]. |- | Fire Cost Down | Decreases the amount of [[Magic Gauge]] consumed by [[Fairy Magic]] for [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Fire [[Element]]. |- | Water Damage Up | Increases the power of [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Water [[Element]]. |- | Water Cost Down | Decreases the amount of [[Magic Gauge]] consumed by [[Fairy Magic]] for [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Water [[Element]]. |- | Lightning Damage Up | Increases the power of [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Lightning [[Element]]. |- | Lightning Cost Down | Decreases the amount of [[Magic Gauge]] consumed by [[Fairy Magic]] for [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Lightning [[Element]]. |- | Light Damage Up | Increases the power of [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Light [[Element]]. |- | Light Cost Down | Decreases the amount of [[Magic Gauge]] consumed by [[Fairy Magic]] for [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Light [[Element]]. |- | Darkness Damage Up | Increases the power of [[Fairy Magic]] used by [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Darkness [[Element]]. |- | Darkness Cost Down | Decreases the amount of [[Magic Gauge]] consumed by [[Fairy Magic]] for [[Companion Fairy|Companion Fairies]] with the Darkness [[Element]]. }} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * {{Guide/BotW Piggyback}} lists an additional Added Effect in {{BotW}} known as "Stal Lure" that can be found on each piece of the [[Radiant Set]].
